notes.title: Update 0.6.19
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with Takeru's ability "Oboro Stream."
- Adjusted collisions in the boss floor of the Sky Castle stage.
- Improved an issue where the screen would flicker in some cases.
- Enhanced the hero ability list in exploration data: abilities at max level now display "(Max)."
- Other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6.18
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the shield break effect was incorrectly displayed on monsters.
- Fixed an issue where Rustil's voice would play after clearing high-difficulty floors.
- Improved visibility of objects such as trees.
- Key items can now be brought in and taken out like regular items.
- Improved the unlocking timing for items such as Service Tickets and Familiar Piece Fusion Pots.
  Now, the related events will trigger even if the items are in your inventory or storage.
- Fixed an issue where spheres and pieces could be delivered to the Familiar management NPC in the shop area.
- Added "Guard Break" property to certain weapon skills. Blocking these attacks will force a heavy stagger.
  Currently applied experimentally to Charge Slash and Photon Burst.
- Added a toggle in the equipment screen to enable/disable switching of floating weapons.
- Adjustments to the monster "Seraphirus":
  - Increased the delay before the laser attack after HP drops below 50% by 0.5 seconds.
  - Removed lock-on from bombardment attacks; now fires in a fixed direction.
  - Reduced bombardment attack count from 2 to 1.
  - Barrier action is now triggered a fixed number of times based on current HP percentage instead of by probability and cooldown.
    Will not perform barrier actions while enraged.
- Various other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6.17
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where HP would instantly recover when equipping the Princess Armor.
- Fixed a bug where summoned monsters did not regain health upon being re-summoned using summoning magic.
- Fixed an issue where the zoom level with the mouse wheel in camera mode was too small.
- Optimized rendering performance.
- Removed the Holy Maiden’s ability "Guardian."
- Added a new ability for the Holy Maiden: "Vanish" – unleashes an area magic attack while guarding with a shield.
- Improved the Holy Maiden’s talent: added a maximum HP multiplier.
- Improved the Sword Saint’s ability "Shield Mastery": now allows shield guarding even while staggered or knocked up.
- Fixed a bug where key configuration changes wouldn't apply until restarting.
- Changed the title of the hero Takeru to "Magic Blade Deity."
- Added a new ability for Magic Blade Deity: "Oboro Stream."
- Changed the names of some hero abilities and other related adjustments.
- Various other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Updeate 0.6.16
notes.notes:
- Fixed stage-related bugs.
- Improved minimap visibility for better readability.
- Removed the feature where holding the dodge button triggers a dash.
- Fixed an issue where all summoned monsters appeared in red on the minimap.
- You can now organize your Familiars on the shop floor.
- Added new attack types to certain monsters.
- Added new regular monsters.
- Various other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6.15
notes.notes:
- A Labyrinth Deliveryman has been added to the shop floor.
- Adjustments made to high-difficulty floor mechanics.
- UI now supports display for the Nintendo Switch Pro Controller.
- Increased invincibility duration during dodging: 0.2 seconds → 0.4 seconds.
- Shield system changes:
  - Damage calculation for shields has been reworked. Attacks now have dedicated shield damage values, making shields more viable even against high-level monsters.
  - "Partially broken" state has been removed. Shields now break when HP reaches 0.
  - Broken shields no longer result in item loss. They become unusable but can be repaired and used again.
  - Successfully blocking with a shield now consumes a small amount of stamina.
- Three staircases will now appear on each floor by default, with each having a chance to become a high-difficulty or bonus staircase.
- Jumping while dodging or dashing will now result in a high jump.
- Armor skill for the Ikusa Costume has been changed.
- Enhanced the skill "Shield" for Knight Armor: Damage reduction increased from 10% to 20%.
- New item: Weapon Skill Change Scroll — Randomly changes one skill on your weapon.
- New item: Repair Scroll — Can repair damaged equipment from your inventory.
- You can now change the order of weapon skills from the equipment menu.
- In the Heroic Spirit Sanctum floor, at least one treasure room is now guaranteed to appear.
- Adjusted the Swordmaster ability "Sword Chain": Increased invincibility time during flight.
- Performing a perfect dodge now restores stamina.
- Set the rate at which individual differences change based on the level of the captured monster (up to a maximum level of 1000).
- Various other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6.14
notes.notes:
- Fixed a problem in which items continued to be displayed after sale when selling items at Iris.
- Other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6.13
notes.notes:
- After clearing Beginner Mode, an NPC named "Traveling Merchant Irisfelis" will appear at your home.
  The following functions are available:
  - Sale of consumable items and scrolls.
  - Selling of items in your inventory.
  - Buying back lost equipment.
- Fixed a bug where the maximum level was not restored correctly when resuming the game.
- Added new weapon skills to some types of weapons.
- Other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6.12
notes.notes:
- Improved the ability to specify the quantity when discarding items.
- When in item selection mode, you can now press the interaction button to view the details of the focused drop item.
- Added a slight delay to the confirmation button when selecting hero abilities.
- Fixed an issue where the game could become unresponsive during language selection.
- Fixed a bug where the FPS settings were not functioning correctly.
- Other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 0.6.11
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the camera couldn't rotate in Free Camera Mode when locking onto a monster.
- Fixed a bug where the confirmation message window was not displaying correctly.
- In key configuration, Gamepad settings can now also be deleted using the Delete key.
- Reduced the price of the insurance premium for the item insurance service.
- Changed scroll items to grant invincibility for a certain time when used.
- Changed the player’s spawn location to a random place.
- Changed the method of obtaining "Hero’s Relic": Previously… eliminate all monsters in the Spirit Hall’s Monster House; Now… drop from special monsters that appear in the Spirit Hall.
- Changed so that important items like "Hero’s Relic" can now be discarded.
- Added the braver ability "Heroic Awakening": Increases the recovery rate of the Hero Skill Gauge.
- Adjusted the sword saint ability "Sword Chain": Added a brief period of invincibility while flying.
- Improved "The Soul of the Nameless One": Now 5 different abilities can be obtained besides items.
- Increased the spawn rate of Soul Orbs in Bonus Rooms and added an experience bonus effect for higher floors. Money is placed.
- Added an option in settings to "Hide details when selecting a safe item" and adjusted the position of the item detail information window.
- Improved the shop: Added a dedicated counter for selling scroll-type items.
- Changed so that minions summoned by monsters no longer drop items or other things.
- Fixed bugs in monster AI.
- Fixed a bug where familiars would not warp to their summoner.
- Adjusted the monster "DoroEmon": Increased the time before it disappears after stealing items.
- Adjusted the monster "Seraphilas": Reduced the frequency of teleport usage.
- Other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: New Year Event
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!
A special event is being held this January where you can obtain the armor item "New Year's Kimono"!
Let's go to the Labyrinth Castle for the New Year's visit while wearing the New Year's Kimono!

A "New Year's Man" will appear at your house.
Monsters drop "Kagami Mochi" when defeated.
Bring the "Kagami Mochi" to the New Year's Man to exchange them for the New Year's Kimono.

notes.title: Update 0.6.10
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where some items could not be obtained properly when the inventory was at maximum capacity.
- Set the base critical damage rate from 0% to 20%.
- Moved the location of the "Service Ticket" in the shop to a more visible position.
- Fixed an issue where the "Labyrinth Guards" could be targeted for elimination.
- Added two "Item Bag Expansion" skills to the skill tree.
- Improved item selection mode (LT) to display detailed information about the selected item.
- Improved item selection mode (LT) to allow weapon switching (RT).
- Updated key configuration to allow mapping mouse wheel up and down, and added a key setting deletion function.
- Fixed a bug where the recovery ability of the Princess Armor would not activate.
- Adjusted the monster "Seraphilas": weakened shield ability, reduced effect time, and decreased durability.
- Fixed some translations.
- Other minor fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Update 0.6.9
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where floating weapons would unequip.
- Fixed untranslated text.
- Fixed an issue where the Familiar would not display at the house.
- Fixed an issue where confirmation messages would not appear in some cases.

notes.title: Update 0.6.8
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug with the display of the skill tree.
- Fixed a bug where the monster "Yuki-Onna" would not use healing.
- Fixed a bug where the camera would stop moving when switching between camera modes.

notes.title: Update 0.6.7
notes.notes:
- Added "Maximum Frame Rate" setting.
- Added "Labyrinth Dressing Room" to the service man. Some equipment can now be changed visually.
- Added an accessory filter to the item-related window filters.
- Improved the player menu to allow checking the status of companion familiars.
- Fixed a bug where the stats of enhanced familiars were increasing incorrectly.
- Changes to the summoning skills of Sluze and Seraphilas. If there are no monsters summoned, the skill will now resummon (with a cooldown). The number of summons has been reduced from 3 to 2.
- Added free camera mode.
- Reduced the difficulty of Monster House when the Hero Relic has not been obtained.
- Other minor fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Update 0.6.6
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that prevented progressing to the next renovation in the Sky Castle.
- Fixed a bug where dropped items would float in mid-air.
- Improved the ability to transition to a dash by holding the dodge button.
- Added an option in the settings to toggle the simplified weapon skill usage on/off.
- Fixed a bug where keyboard and mouse inputs were not functional on the Familiar Enhancement screen.
- Fixed a bug where dungeon generation in the Divine Demon Castle was not working correctly.
- Adjusted the monster "Seraphilas": modified some of its attacks.
- Fixed a bug where mouse input would become unresponsive during UI operations.
- Other optimizations and minor fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.6.5
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where some ally characters could not pass through.
- Fixed an issue where the floor collision detection in the treasure chest room of the Sky Castle floor disappeared.
- Fixed an issue where the descriptions of hero abilities were not displayed.
- Added new accessory items.
- Changed the items that can be stolen from bosses.
- Other minor fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Update 0.6.4
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where Rustil became invincible during summoning.
- Increased the drop rate of accessories from bosses.
- Adjusted additional effects based on weapon rarity.
- Adjusted the monster "Seraphyrus": visualized damage-blocking barrier and made it destructible.
- Improved the ability to progress to the next floor after the hero's soul acquisition event in the temporary Story mode.
- Fixed a bug where the "Max Level +1" in the skill tree was not being applied.
- Adjusted the hero's ability "Step avoidance": shortened the timing for re-dodging.
- Fixed a bug where ability descriptions were not displayed.
- Added the hero's ability "Blazing Flash."
- Fixed a bug where the safety mode in regular exploration was not functioning.
- Optimized certain stages.
- Other minor fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Update 0.6.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the accessory "Princess Tiara" would change into cat ears.
- Fixed a bug that when an ally summoned a monster, it was included in the floor clear target.
- Fixed untranslated sections.

notes.title: Correction of 0.6.2
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where the durability of shields was set to 0.

notes.title: Update 0.6.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed bugs in infinite exploration.
- Significantly increased the appearance rates of the hero souls "Magician Meltina" and "Braver Lato (after floor 50)".
- Changed some equipment so that their base performance varies by rarity.
- Fixed a bug where invisible walls existed in the Sky Castle.
- Improved floor analysis objects to also detect items and traps.
- Changes to traps:
- Some traps can now activate multiple times.
- Some traps can now be destroyed with melee attacks.
- Reduced the price of service tickets.
- Increased the drop rate of accessories from bosses.
- Fixed a bug where treasure chests did not appear in normal exploration, survival exploration, and the final room.
- Changed so that slow-motion effects do not occur when non-player characters perform a shast guard.
- Adjusted the monster "Giant God Warrior": it will no longer stagger from normal attacks.
- Adjusted the monster "Thrud": limited the maximum summonable number to 3. Fixed a bug where summoned monsters would turn hostile.

- Other minor fixes and adjustments.

notes.title: Update 0.6.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where insurance could not be applied to accessories.
- Adjusted the Holy Maiden's ability "Holy Guard": corrected the attack power debuff and fixed the misalignment of the level indication for becoming indestructible.
- Adjusted the Holy Maiden's ability "Sacred Devotion": fixed a bug where HP was not being restored.
- Fixed a bug that caused only the soul to be reduced when acquiring hero abilities.
- Corrected untranslated portions.

notes.title: Big Update 0.6.0
notes.notes:
- Added new floor: "Sky Castle."
- Added new hero: "Holy Maiden Nevia."
- Added new monsters.
- Added new equipment items.
- Added new accessory items.
- Added familiars piece synthesis feature.

notes.notes:
Big Update on October 15!
New floors and monsters are being introduced, along with improvements to bugs and other issues.
Enjoy the new labyrinth castle!

Update Details(Ver 0.6.0)
- Added new floor: "Sky Castle."
- Added new hero: "Holy Maiden Nevia."
- Added new monsters.
- Added new equipment items.
- Added new accessory items.
- Added familiars piece synthesis feature.

notes.title: Update 0.5.31
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that shopkeepers did not attack when stealing from a store in safe exploration mode.
- Improved to be able to lock on to all enemies.
  (On/Off by pushing in the right analog stick, toggled by left/right input.)
- Changed the color of enemy HP.
- Fixed the appearance of service tickets in the old castle monster house even in free mode.
- Added a setting to slow down when selecting items.
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.5.30
notes.notes:
- Added a feature in normal mode/free mode where difficulty can be selected at the start.
  - Normal exploration… same as before.
  - Safe exploration… instead of no item loss, penalties are added (reduced drop rate, reduced high rare rate, decreased individual differences in captured monsters).
- Abolished practice mode.
- Added “item bag expansion” to the skill tree.
- Changed captured monsters to be treated as items.
  - Take them home and access “Familiar Management” to make them your companions.
  - When used as an item, summon them on the spot, and the item disappears.
- Changes to early access game progress:
  - Abolished the door to another world and added service tickets instead (activate the service man).
  - Enabled online battles with the trainer’s relics.
- Renewal of home.
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.5.29
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug in which the level of bosses did not change with the increase in the number of hierarchy.

notes.title: Update 0.5.28
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug in which the program would not progress during loading due to a stage loading error.
- To address unexpected freezes and forced shutdowns, saving on a per-level basis will occur until the game stabilizes.
- Correction of the location of the appearance of the stairs in the stage of the Divine Demons Castle.

notes.title: Update 0.5.27
notes.notes:
- When stealing items in the shop, all products change to regular drop items.
- The Labyrinth Deliveryman disappears after a certain time from the start of movement.
- Correction of untranslated sections.
- Fixed a display bug in exploration data.
- Improved display of exploration data (hide parameters of the next level).
- Improved controller operation screen.
- Display weapon types in the item detail window.
- Specification change for Hero Soul statues:
  - Random abilities or items appear from all heroes who have acquired talents.
  - If no talents have been acquired, only items appear.
- Improved stages in the Divine Demons Castle.

notes.title: Update 0.5.26
notes.notes:
- Added the ability to select the starting level in the free mode, allowing users to start their search from the 1st, 25th, 49th, 73rd, or 97th floors of the old castle.
  A designated hierarchy start must reach that hierarchy at least once.
  The initial level is one-third of the hierarchy and souls begin unclaimed.
- Due to internal system changes in event relations, some event flags will be reset.
  *Some events, such as each release event at home, will be shown again.
- Memory-related optimization.

notes.title: Update 0.5.25
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug in the operation of the Labyrinth Delivery Agent when delivering familier enhancement pieces.
- Fixed "Steal" was selected when the Cancel button was pressed during store purchase.

notes.title: Update 0.5.24
notes.notes:
- Improved the blocked entrance of the sliding door room in the castle of the god of demons. Fixed durability value for sliding doors.
- Labyrinth Deliveryman now appears. Appears with a probability in the tiers other than stores and bosses. Up to two packages can be transferred to the home warehouse.
- Item shortcut function added. Only one type of consumable item can be selected and used instantly.
- Improved key configuration. For example, Interaction and Attack work correctly with the same key.
- The level of detail of the mini-map has been improved, except for the old castle.
- Other minor corrections and improvements.

notes.title: 0.5.23 Fix
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that prevented resuming from an interrupted save.z

notes.title: Update 0.5.23
notes.notes:
- The number of floating weapons equipped was corrected to be normal when restoring an interrupted save.
- Adjustment of the ability "Guided Magic Bombardment": increase the search range. It now targets crates and other objects.
- Fixed a bug that prevented some of the reserved familiars from being summoned correctly.
- Fixed a bug that allowed duplicate hero skills to be acquired.
- Adjusted the weapon type "Rifle Sword" so that critical hits are generated by shooting.
- Improved drop items so that they do not overlap.
- Some objects in the Divine Demons Castle are now destructible.
- Shape images are displayed in the detailed information of the familial enhancement piece as an item.
- Adjust the closest camera mode.
- Adjustment of the ability "Magic Bind": effect duration and value reduced.
- Adjustment of wand magic: increased power of the final combo (linear magic).
- Improvements to the Familiar Enhancement Screen.
- Have nearby items and treasure chests displayed on the minimap.
- Other minor corrections.

notes.title: Update 0.5.22
notes.notes:
- Fixed a problem that prevented sorting of familiars at times.
- Do not display a confirmation message when discarding an item.
- Added the ability to sell items in the store.
- Drop items and store items are now also restored when restoring a mid-save.
- Fixed a bug that caused inoperability in the Familiar management screen.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the serviceman's screen from being operated with the mouse.
- Adjustment of the Heroic Skill Gauge: increase in the amount required.
  Heroic Gauge should be easier to accumulate with melee attacks.
  Magic is more likely to accumulate with combo attacks and weapon skills.
  To accumulate even when damaged.
- Eliminated the hero skill "Floating Sword Burst" for the hero Wilhelm.
- Added the hero skill "Berserk" for the hero Wilhelm: Physical attack power, physical/magical defense and attack speed are increased for a certain time.
  Physical attack and physical/magical defense are level-dependent; increases up to 3.5x at lvl 50.
- 敵AIの調整：ヘイトの高いキャラクターが攻撃対象になりやすくする。
- Adjustment of the skull head: re-summoning time. Addition of the special attack "5 Way Shot" (character: only used above 80% offensively).
- Adjustment of the ability "Summoning Art": modified so that the skill is activated at the normal level. Adjustment of summoning time.
- Adjustment of the ability "Guided magic bombardment": corrected so that the skill is activated at the normal level.
- Changed to display the rarity of the piece in the Familiar Enhancement Piece List.
- Changed the money for panel reset to be based on the amount of money in possession, including warehouse. 
- Other minor corrections.

notes.title: Update 0.5.21
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that character creation did not proceed when starting a new game.

notes.title: Update 0.5.20
notes.notes:
- A "ServiceMan" appears in your home (when you clear the beginner mode).
　The item insurance function has been tentatively implemented, and a hair style change function has been added.
- Displayed tips on the "Heroic Spirit Sanctum" floor of the Divine Demon Castle (boss appearance conditions, etc.).
- Added sorting function for Familiars in possession.
- Fixed a bug that the automatic recovery of the armor "Princess Armor" did not work properly.
- The number of traps on the floors that are not high difficulty levels has been reduced.
- Fixed a bug that the equipment mark of an item was not displayed.
- The ability "Lightning Sword" has been adjusted: the power has been changed from 40% magic to 20% physical + 20% magic.

notes.title: Update 0.5.19 fix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented monster houses from appearing in the Divine Demon Castle.

notes.title: Update 0.5.19
notes.notes:
- The treasure rooms are more likely to appear after the 25th level and at higher levels.
- Graphics Quality" was added to the settings. This affects the quality of shadows and distant objects.
- The number of levels in the "Zekkyo" was one less than in other areas, so it was increased by one.
- Adjustment of potions: green...100 + 5% recovery of max HP, red...300 + 10% of max HP, increase in the price sold in the store.
- The movement speed of monsters with increased lvl was limited to a certain value.
- The attack speed is now affected during slashing attacks with the special attack "Sword Chain" with a sword.
- Improved the ability to return to the ground when the ground is penetrated on the boss floor of the Divin Demon Castle.
- Adjustment of the Scroll of Strong Wind: The range of the scroll has been increased.
- Adjustment of the Scroll of Explosion: changed the power from 100% magic to 60% physical + 60% magic.

notes.title: Update 0.5.18
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that prevented returning from the Familiar screen.
- Fixed a bug that the performance of familiars' reinforcement pieces were not remembered and re-lottery when the game was saved.
- Added key configurations to the settings.
- Added a function to change the resolution in the settings.
- Added a texture quality setting to the settings.
- Adjustment of the time to re-summon Otomo Familiars.
- Improved the phenomenon that sometimes nothing comes out of the golden treasure chest.
- Added more items to the store. Made it easier to get a Support Rod.
- Increased the free mode time limit by 30%.
- Weapons can now be switched while dashing.
- Adjustment of the "Lightning speed" ability of the heroes: Fixed a bug that the critical rate does not increase. Parameter adjustment. Maximum Lv. 3 to 5.
- Adjustment of the "Lightning sword" ability: Increased the number of hits required.
- Addition of the ability "Aggressive Initiative" for the heroes.
- Adjustment of the normal attack of the sword: Increased the power of the 5th stage attack.
- Added a damage indicator to the "Punching bag".
- Fixed a bug that caused some monsters/familiars to use their skills in succession.
- Added the ability to delete familiars' reinforcement pieces.

notes.title: Update 0.5.17
notes.notes:
- Correction of the appearance probability of the golden treasure chest.
- Added "Exploration Data" item on the menu screen. It is now possible to check the possessed hero abilities and captured familiars.
- Added an interruption save function. The freeze restore function has also been integrated here.
　An interruption portal is located on the store floor, where interruption saves can be made. When you return, you will start from the store floor.
　(The interruption portal disappears in the store when you return, so you need to proceed to the next store)
　If the game freezes, it rolls back to the last store.
- The item "Supporting Rod" is added. If you have it, you can avoid the "Falling Trap".
　Each time you avoid a trap, the number of items will decrease by one (up to 50 items can be grouped together).

notes.title: Update 0.5.16
notes.notes:
― Fixed a bug that prevented specifying the number of items in the warehouse.
― Improved the operation of the warehouse.
― Fixed a bug that "Discard" did not work in the warehouse.
― Improved the display of items in the "Use Items" window (lower left corner of the screen) by grouping them together for better visibility.
  The item selection loop has been improved.
― A confirmation message is now displayed when using the scroll of return.
― Fixed a bug that the effect of charge magic remains.
― The menu can be opened while dashing.
― All actions now pick up money automatically.
― The menu can now be opened while dashing or evading.
― Improved dropped items so that they do not float in the air.
― Fixed the stage map.
― The golden treasure chests that tend to produce high rarities now appear in the treasure room after the 25th floor.
― The sensing scroll now displays drop items and treasure chests on the mini-map.
― The mini-map has been improved.
― Fixed a behavior that normal attack from the end of a dash becomes a special attack when a wand and a rifle sword are equipped.

notes.title: Update 0.5.15
notes.notes:
- Fixed various bugs in the stage.
- Adjustment of magic attack: increase in power of rotating jump magic.
- Adjustments to charge magic: 1st stage = decrease hit stop time & increase hit interval, 2nd stage = increase power, 3rd stage = increase power, 4th stage = increase power
- Fixed the special attack of the sword item "Harscale".
- Fixed a bug that the sword item "Dojikiri" did not get a rarity buff.
- Adjustment of the ability "Sword Sage Awakening": slightly increased power.
- Adjustment of the ability "Charge Slash": physical defense penetration of the last hit is reduced to 20%.
- Adjustment to the ability "Step avoidance": so that the jump is triggered.
- Adjustment of the ability "Magic Power Supply": from 0.2 to 1.0 to 0.1 to 0.6. Maximum Lv 5 to 6.
- Adjustment of the ability "Earth Spike": reduced knock-up, reduced judgment range, reduced effect of defensive debuffs.
- Adjustment of ability "Sword Chain Enhancement": add buff to increase arm strength when used (can be stacked).
- Display a confirmation message when selecting practice mode.
- Improved that some effects remained in memory without disappearing.
- Fixed a bug in the possession familiars menu that caused the process to become slow.
- Fixed a bug that the personality "Cautious" did not appear in the Familiar reinforcement piece.
- Improved "About Familiar" tips can be displayed in the Familiar management menu.
- The save data restoration function when a game is terminated abnormally has been improved so that a confirmation message can be displayed and selected at the time of restoration.
- Fixed a bug that prevented souls from appearing on the high difficulty floor of the "Divine Demon Castle".
- Boss-type monsters are now also enhanced in down value and armor value according to their lvl.
- Improved display of a message at the end of the capture stone effect.
- Fixed so that when an item is selected when acquiring heroic abilities, the acquired item does not disappear even if the bag is full.

notes.title: Update 0.5.14
notes.notes:
- (Important) Fixed a bug that caused a rollback to the previous state at the start of the game.
- Reduction of resource data.

notes.title: Update 0.5.13
notes.notes:
- In case of a game freeze, ensure that items are restored to their pre-exploration state.
- Make the window size in windowed mode adjustable.
- Add mouse sensitivity and left/right inversion options to the settings.
- Fix the issue with special attacks for each weapon type (sword chain, magic attack, shooting) not functioning properly.

notes.title: Update 0.5.12
notes.notes:
- Fixed an infinite hit bug in the "lightning sword strike" ability.
- Adjustment of the "Charge Slash" ability: increased power, 50% additional physical defense penetration for the last hit.
- Fixed a bug that prevented souls from appearing on the high difficulty floor of the Zekkyo.
- Fixed a bug in which installed Familiar reinforcement pieces were displayed in the piece list.
- Added full screen display switching of the mini-map with the Select button (Tab key).

notes.title: Update 0.5.11
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that the Wave Sword Strike Lv3 was not activated.
- Fixed a bug that the status of captured monsters became fixed.
- The individual status of captured monsters has been adjusted so that the higher the Lvl, the more likely it is to have a higher status.
- Fixed a bug that prevented Familiar: Death Knight from warping to the summoner.
- Fixed a bug that caused floating weapons to be unequipped.
- Weapon Skill: Adjusted the power of Multi Sword Slash.
- The setting can now be toggled between Window mode and Full Screen mode.
- Relaxed the time limit in Story Mode (except Free Mode).
- Adjusted the performance of Princess Armor. The reinforcement can be increased up to +50.
- Adjustment of the performance of the Golden Armor. The armor can be strengthened up to +99.

- The return portal appears on the boss floor when the boss is defeated.
- Fixed a bug in the proliferation of items in the warehouse.
- The phenomenon that an enemy stops moving has been improved.
- The camera lock function when summoning a boss has been improved.
- Adjusted the power of Melutina's ability: charge magic.
- Improved monster collision.
- Corrected a mistake in item description.
- Takeru's ability: Adjusted the performance of enchanted weapons.
- Adjustment of detection ability of dungeon monsters.

notes.title: Version 0.5.9
notes.notes:
In Beginner Mode clear, changed to unlock the soul of "Magician Meltina".
Improved keyboard controls in the warehouse.
Even if "Trainer Nekuta" is not unlocked, allow the use of capture stones (unlocking Nekuta is required for summoning).
Enhanced item UI selection position to not reset when obtaining items.
Fixed bug causing disappearance of warehouse items.
Fixed skill tree bugs.
Fixed bug where rarity buffs were not applied to gunblade-type weapons.
